facts.note: Transcript has Girard refuse to show the master his watch at dinner ("I would not"), then sit alone in the dining room with the brandy, hear the temple strike ten there, and not look at his watch.
Went out to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch (10:34), heard faint quick bells from the master's window up above.
Came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; went straight up to Félix in the library.
